reviews.title: Decent sound but connectivity hiccups
reviews.comment: The WaveDrive Smart Speaker delivers clear mids and decent bass for its size, and the voice assistant responds quickly most of the time. However, I’ve experienced occasional Bluetooth dropouts that interrupt my music playback.

reviews.title: Good features, but battery drains fast
reviews.comment: I appreciate the built‑in Wi‑Fi and the intuitive touch controls on the WaveDrive, which make streaming from the app a breeze. The downside is the battery life, which barely lasts five hours on a full charge.

reviews.title: Disappointing audio quality and lag
reviews.comment: The speaker’s sound feels tinny and lacks the depth I expected from a smart speaker. In addition, voice commands often lag, making the assistant feel unresponsive.

reviews.title: Unreliable Wi‑Fi and flimsy build
reviews.comment: Connecting the WaveDrive to my home network is frustrating; it drops the Wi‑Fi signal frequently. The plastic housing also feels cheap and rattles when I move it.

reviews.title: Limited EQ and poor app integration
reviews.comment: There are only a few preset EQ settings, which don’t let me personalize the sound. The companion app frequently crashes, preventing me from adjusting volume or playlists reliably.
